detail.longDescription: ACME, Docker and web admin folks. I need to request a cert via ACME for an application that runs in docker. I have no access to the container, I just put the cert in a location on the host and the application periodically ingests it. I have a cert provider, keys and hmacs, but acme.sh and certbot STILL want hooks into apache, which I can't give. The host is in private IP space, so no one is checking whatever they are doing anyway. DNS-PERSIST is "almost here", so not quite ready I guess. Where do I go from here? # acme # certbot # docker [Short of using another server for the request and scp'ing it. Ugly but would work.]
